explicit_propositions.text: The Clean Label Project tested 160 top-selling protein powders in the United States.
Nearly half (47%) of those protein powders exceeded the Proposition 65 safety threshold for lead.
Puri's PW1 whey protein undergoes third-party testing by the Clean Label Project for over 200 contaminants.
Consuming protein powder daily increases concern about contaminant exposure.
No Puri product is sold unless it passes the Clean Label Project’s testing standards.
Puri's PW1 is the only protein in the U.S. with Clean Label Project Transparency Certification.
Puri makes its third-party test results publicly accessible via a QR code on the label.
Each serving of PW1 contains 21 grams of minimally processed, high-quality whey protein from pasture-raised cow's milk.
PW1 contains no hormones, no GMOs, and no pesticides.
Jeff personally enjoys the bourbon vanilla flavor of PW1 and finds it free of artificial ingredients and excessive sweetness.
